corridor_notes: GEM row = Heshan Branch of the Guangxi Gas Branch Pipeline Network (广西天然气支线管网项目合山天然气支线管道工程), operator Guangxi Gas Group (广西广投天然气管网有限公司); Xingbin District -> Heshan City, ~33km, proposed. The pilot (prior) pass located two 2019 government filings that independently name this exact project -- a Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources land-use pre-review (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841, doc 桂自然资预审〔2019〕49号, dated 2019-07-24) and a Guangxi DRC core-approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864, ~2019-09-27, investment RMB 128.02M -- an exact match to GEM's SegmentCost) -- confirming existence and general corridor (Xingbin to Heshan), but neither document names a specific 分输站 (distribution station) or township along the route. This session re-attempted both live and via Wayback Machine; neither was reachable (see blockers). No alternate publication naming a finer point was found before this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted.
researcher_notes: Existence of this exact branch is independently corroborated (2019 land-use pre-review + DRC core-approval, investment figure exact match to GEM) even though neither underlying document could be re-fetched this session. Per the pilot's separate status_review (out of scope for this route-creation task), this branch shows no independently-dated activity after 2019 -- 7 years dormant vs. sibling branches on the same program (e.g. Qianjiang) that show 2025 activity -- a 'shelved' status recommendation is already logged elsewhere.
blockers: No verifiable ([ref]-passable) URL was found for either endpoint at station or township granularity, matching the outcome anticipated in this task's SPECIAL NOTES. The two known primary documents (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841; fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864) are on the gxzf.gov.cn domain family, which ConnectTimeouts/ECONNREFUSEDs from this environment on every attempt (curl and WebFetch). Wayback Machine (archive.org) lookups for these two URLs returned persistent HTTP 429 (rate-limited) throughout this session, likely from concurrent sibling agents sharing this sandbox's egress IP -- could not obtain an archived snapshot either. Coordinates given are county/city-level Nominatim centroids only, not a sourced pipeline endpoint or station.
